            w = feats[start:i+1]
            if len(w) < window:
                pad = np.zeros((window - len(w), feat_dim), dtype=np.float32)
                w = np.concatenate([pad, w], axis=0)
            X.append(w.flatten())
            y.append(labels[i])
    return np.array(X, dtype=np.float32), np.array(y)


def predict_per_trace(clf, traces, feat_fn, window, feat_dim):
    all_preds, all_labels = [], []
    for t in traces:
        feats = feat_fn(t)
        labels = np.array(t["step_labels"])
        n = min(len(labels), feats.shape[0])
        feats, labels = feats[:n], labels[:n]
        X_trace = []
        for i in range(n):
            start = max(0, i - window + 1)
            w = feats[start:i+1]
            if len(w) < window:
                pad = np.zeros((window - len(w), feat_dim), dtype=np.float32)
                w = np.concatenate([pad, w], axis=0)
            X_trace.append(w.flatten())
        X_trace = np.array(X_trace, dtype=np.float32)
        preds = clf.predict(X_trace)
        all_preds.append(preds)
        all_labels.append(labels)
    return all_preds, all_labels


def compute_per_trace_bal_acc(preds_list, labels_list):
    bal_accs = []
    for preds, labels in zip(preds_list, labels_list):
        pos_mask = labels == 1
        neg_mask = labels == 0
        tpr = np.mean(preds[pos_mask] == 1) if pos_mask.sum() > 0 else np.nan
        tnr = np.mean(preds[neg_mask] == 0) if neg_mask.sum() > 0 else np.nan
        if np.isnan(tpr) or np.isnan(tnr):
            bal_accs.append(np.nan)
        else:
            bal_accs.append((tpr + tnr) / 2.0)
    return np.array(bal_accs)


def compute_per_trace_precision(preds_list, labels_list):
    precs = []
    for preds, labels in zip(preds_list, labels_list):
        tp = np.sum((preds == 1) & (labels == 1))
        fp = np.sum((preds == 1) & (labels == 0))
        if tp + fp == 0:
            precs.append(np.nan)
        else:
            precs.append(tp / (tp + fp))
    return np.array(precs)


def compute_per_trace_precp_fpr(preds_list, traces):
    fprs, valid_idx = [], []
    for i, (preds, t) in enumerate(zip(preds_list, traces)):
        cp = t["commitment_point"]
        if cp is None or cp == 0:
            continue
        pre_preds = preds[:cp]
        if len(pre_preds) == 0:
            continue
        fprs.append(pre_preds.sum() / len(pre_preds))
        valid_idx.append(i)
    return np.array(fprs), valid_idx


def first_crossing(probs, threshold=0.5, k=K_CONSEC):
    for i in range(len(probs) - k + 1):
        if all(p > threshold for p in probs[i:i+k]):
            return i
    return None


def compute_coverage_lead(clf, traces, feat_fn, window, feat_dim):
    n_crossings, lead_times = 0, []
    for t in traces:
        feats = feat_fn(t)
        labels = np.array(t["step_labels"])
        n = min(len(labels), feats.shape[0])
        feats, labels = feats[:n], labels[:n]
        cp = t["commitment_point"]
        X_trace = []
        for i in range(n):
            start = max(0, i - window + 1)
            w = feats[start:i+1]
            if len(w) < window:
                pad = np.zeros((window - len(w), feat_dim), dtype=np.float32)
                w = np.concatenate([pad, w], axis=0)
            X_trace.append(w.flatten())
        X_trace = np.array(X_trace, dtype=np.float32)
        probs = clf.predict_proba(X_trace)[:, 1]
        fc = first_crossing(probs.tolist(), threshold=0.5, k=K_CONSEC)
        if fc is not None and fc < cp:
            n_crossings += 1
            lead_times.append(cp - fc)
    coverage = n_crossings / len(traces) if traces else 0.0
    lead_mean = float(np.mean(lead_times)) if lead_times else 0.0
    return coverage, lead_mean


def paired_bootstrap_null_centered(diffs, n_resamples=N_BOOTSTRAP, seed=SEED):
    """Null-centered two-sided bootstrap p-value."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n = len(diffs)
    obs = np.mean(diffs)
    boot_deltas = np.zeros(n_resamples)
    for b in range(n_resamples):
        idx = rng.integers(0, n, size=n)
        boot_deltas[b] = np.mean(diffs[idx])
    bd_null = boot_deltas - np.mean(boot_deltas)
    p_value = float(np.mean(np.abs(bd_null) >= np.abs(obs)))
    ci_lower = float(np.percentile(boot_deltas, 2.5))
    ci_upper = float(np.percentile(boot_deltas, 97.5))
    return {
        "observed_diff": float(obs),
        "mean_diff": float(np.mean(boot_deltas)),
        "ci95": [ci_lower, ci_upper],
        "p_value": p_value,
    }


def run_probe_and_bootstrap(train, test, window, layer_idx, st_model):
    log(f"  --- W={window}, Layer={layer_idx} ---")

    def hs_feat(t):
        return t["hidden_states"][:, layer_idx, :].numpy().astype(np.float32)
    def text_feat(t):
        return t["text_embeddings"]

    t0 = time.time()
    X_hs, y_hs = build_temporal_features(train, hs_feat, window, HIDDEN_DIM)
    use_dual = X_hs.shape[1] > X_hs.shape[0]
    clf_hs = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000,
                                 random_state=SEED, solver="liblinear", dual=use_dual)
    clf_hs.fit(X_hs, y_hs)
    log(f"  HS probe: shape={X_hs.shape}, pos_rate={y_hs.mean():.3f}, time={time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    t0 = time.time()
    X_txt, y_txt = build_temporal_features(train, text_feat, window, TEXT_DIM)
    use_dual_txt = X_txt.shape[1] > X_txt.shape[0]
    clf_text = LogisticRegression(C=1.0, class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000,
                                   random_state=SEED, solver="liblinear", dual=use_dual_txt)
    clf_text.fit(X_txt, y_txt)
    log(f"  Text probe: shape={X_txt.shape}, time={time.time()-t0:.1f}s")

    hs_bal = compute_per_trace_bal_acc(hs_preds, hs_labels)
    text_bal = compute_per_trace_bal_acc(text_preds, text_labels)
    valid_bal = ~np.isnan(hs_bal) & ~np.isnan(text_bal)
    hs_bal_v, text_bal_v = hs_bal[valid_bal], text_bal[valid_bal]

    hs_prec = compute_per_trace_precision(hs_preds, hs_labels)
    text_prec = compute_per_trace_precision(text_preds, text_labels)
    valid_prec = ~np.isnan(hs_prec) & ~np.isnan(text_prec)
    hs_prec_v, text_prec_v = hs_prec[valid_prec], text_prec[valid_prec]

    text_fpr, text_fpr_idx = compute_per_trace_precp_fpr(text_preds, test)

    text_fpr_map = dict(zip(text_fpr_idx, text_fpr))

    text_fpr_paired = np.array([text_fpr_map[i] for i in common_idx])

    all_hs_labels = np.concatenate(hs_labels)
    all_text_preds = np.concatenate(text_preds)
    all_text_labels = np.concatenate(text_labels)

    step_text_bal = balanced_accuracy_score(all_text_labels, all_text_preds)

    bal_diff = hs_bal_v - text_bal_v
    prec_diff = hs_prec_v - text_prec_v
    fpr_diff = hs_fpr_paired - text_fpr_paired

    bal_boot = paired_bootstrap_null_centered(bal_diff)
    prec_boot = paired_bootstrap_null_centered(prec_diff)
    fpr_boot = paired_bootstrap_null_centered(fpr_diff)

    bonf = 0.05 / 3

    log(f"  BalAcc: HS={hs_bal_v.mean():.4f}, Text={text_bal_v.mean():.4f}, "
        f"D={bal_boot['observed_diff']:+.4f}, p={bal_boot['p_value']:.4f}, "
        f"CI={bal_boot['ci95']}, {'PASS' if bal_boot['p_value'] < bonf else 'FAIL'}")
    log(f"  Prec:   HS={hs_prec_v.mean():.4f}, Text={text_prec_v.mean():.4f}, "
        f"D={prec_boot['observed_diff']:+.4f}, p={prec_boot['p_value']:.4f}, "
        f"CI={prec_boot['ci95']}, {'PASS' if prec_boot['p_value'] < bonf else 'FAIL'}")
    log(f"  FPR:    HS={hs_fpr_paired.mean():.4f}, Text={text_fpr_paired.mean():.4f}, "
        f"D={fpr_boot['observed_diff']:+.4f}, p={fpr_boot['p_value']:.4f}, "
        f"CI={fpr_boot['ci95']}, {'PASS' if fpr_boot['p_value'] < bonf else 'FAIL'}")

        },
        "bootstrap": {
            "balanced_accuracy": {
                "hs_mean": round(float(hs_bal_v.mean()), 4),

                "observed_diff": round(bal_boot["observed_diff"], 4),

                "p_value": round(bal_boot["p_value"], 4),

def position_baseline(train, test):
    log("\n=== Position Baseline ===")
    X_train, y_train = [], []
    for t in train:
        labels = np.array(t["step_labels"])

- W=3-15: 0/3 (nominally significant for some, but not after Bonferroni)
